Function: Used to check the configuration after generation
Author: Nguyen Quan (user)

Table - Register Definition.Descriprtion: Global engine control and event status. Demonstrates every supported field access policy.

Bits.Description: Number of completed engine operations; supplied by hardware and read by software.
Select operation mode: 0=idle, 1=single, 2=continuous, 3=diagnostic; other values are reserved.
Software requests one operation by writing 1; hardware clears the request after acceptance. A simultaneous software write wins.
Sticky engine-fault flag. Hardware sets it; software writes 1 to clear it. A simultaneous hardware update wins.
Sticky event-pending flag. Software writes 0 to clear it; a write of 1 preserves it. Hardware update wins.
Sticky overflow flag. Any software write to this register clears the field; a simultaneous hardware update wins.
Completion flag. A completed CSR read returns its current value and then clears the field; hardware update wins.
Reserved; reads as zero and has no hardware input.

Table - Register Definition.Descriprtion: Per-port transfer control and event status. Expands to port_0 through port_2 at four-byte intervals.

Bits.Description: Number of completed transfers on this port; supplied by hardware.
Select port mode: 0=disabled, 1=run, 2=step; other values are reserved.
Software requests one port transfer by writing 1; hardware clears the request after acceptance. A simultaneous software write wins.
Sticky port-transfer fault. Hardware sets it; software writes 1 to clear it. A simultaneous hardware update wins.
Sticky port-event flag. Software writes 0 to clear it; a write of 1 preserves it. Hardware update wins.
Sticky event-counter overflow. Any software write to this register clears the field; hardware update wins.
Transfer-complete flag. A completed CSR read returns its current value and then clears the field; hardware update wins.
Reserved; reads as zero and has no hardware input.

Table - Register Definition.Descriprtion: Per-monitor capture control and event status. Default count is 2; the elaboration parameter allows 1 through 4 entries.

Bits.Description: Number of samples captured by this monitor entry; supplied by hardware.
Four-bit event-count threshold used by this monitor entry.
Software requests a sample by writing 1; hardware clears the request when capture completes. A simultaneous software write wins.
Sticky capture-error flag. Hardware sets it; software writes 1 to clear it. A simultaneous hardware update wins.
Sticky trigger-pending flag. Software writes 0 to clear it; a write of 1 preserves it. Hardware update wins.
Sticky lost-sample flag. Any software write to this register clears the field; hardware update wins.
Threshold-match event. A completed CSR read returns its current value and then clears the field; hardware update wins.
Reserved; reads as zero and has no hardware input.
